_about: DataTableFramework registry: the mod tables the framework lists in each composite (run.py).
A mod ships its own table (<Composite>_<Mod>) and registers it here under adopted, then run.py rebuilds the framework pak.
Later parents win a same-named row: vanilla < adopted tables, in the order listed. Keep new row names unique.
A registered table whose mod is not installed is skipped (Rak's RPMTech is listed and absent here). Rows that already shipped keep their names -- saves store them by row name.
channels: the old Ch0001..Ch1000 scheme. The framework no longer ships channel parents or stubs, so a ChNNNN file is never read.
